newsitem.title: UK: Fortune to take 24.5 pct in China venture.
newsitem.headline: Fortune to take 24.5 pct in China venture.

text.p: Fortune Oil Plc said on Thursday that it was taking a 24.5 percent stake in a joint venture that would invest 103 million stg in China.
Fortune's partners would be the China Aviation Oil Supply Corporation and Vitol Holding B.V.
The joint venture will be called South China Bluesky Aviation Oil Company Ltd with Fortune's initial investment in the project put at 12.42 million stg.
The venture would initially provide fuel and aircraft refuelling services at up to 16 airports in southern and central China, including Guangzhou, the second largest airport in China.
Bluesky would supply, store and market aviation fuel for a period of 25 years. It would also market lubricants and other related products to the airline firms, Fortune said.
Fortune, traded on the London Stock Exchange, has operations and investments in the Guangdong province in southern China.
